title: Redefining Stablecoins from Nominal to Real Value: A Maximum Likelihood Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.30225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stablecoins, typically pegged to fiat currencies, cannot achieve true stability because they inherit fluctuations in the underlying unit of account. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a stablecoin pegged to the Maximum Likelihood Value (MLV), a newly defined unit of account derived as the most probable configuration of latent real-value movements that explains observed nominal-value (price) changes. Grounded in inferential statistics and modern portfolio theory, MLV represents the most stable unit of account, as it enforces a zero real return on the minimum-variance portfolio. Empirical results confirm the operational viability of an MLV-pegged stablecoin: MLV can be computed in real time from 500 asset price series and improves annualized returns and Sharpe ratios while substantially reducing turnover in portfolio optimization.

translated_title: 从名义价值到实际价值重新定义稳定币：一种最大似然方法
translated_abstract: 稳定币通常锚定法定货币，但由于其继承了底层记账单位本身的波动性，因而无法实现真正的稳定。为了克服这一局限，我们引入了一种锚定最大似然值的稳定币，MLV是一种新定义的记账单位，它是通过推断统计方法推导出的、能够解释观测到的名义价值（价格）变化的潜在实际价值变动的最可能配置。MLV建立在推断统计学和现代投资组合理论的基础之上，代表了最稳定的记账单位，因为它强制最小方差投资组合的实际收益率为零。实证结果证实了锚定MLV的稳定币在操作上的可行性：MLV可以通过500个资产价格序列实时计算得出，并且在投资组合优化中提高了年化收益率和夏普比率，同时大幅降低了换手率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种锚定最大似然值（MLV）的新型稳定币，MLV是基于推断统计学和现代投资组合理论定义的最稳定记账单位，实证表明其可通过500个资产价格序列实时计算，并能提升投资组合的年化收益率和夏普比率、降低换手率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a stablecoin pegged to the Maximum Likelihood Value (MLV), a newly defined most stable unit of account derived from inferential statistics and modern portfolio theory, demonstrating its real-time computability and its ability to improve portfolio returns and Sharpe ratios while reducing turnover.
